paite: Huan Israel suante apai zel ua, Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
heading: Moab Kumpipa'n Balaam Asam
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Zippor tapa Balak in Israel mite'n Amorte abawldan tengteng uh ana thei hi.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

paite: Moabte'n mite alau mahmah ua, atam ngal ua. Israel suante ziak in Moabte alungkham uhi.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

paite: Moabte'n Midian upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bawng in loupa anekgaih bang in i kim ua mi tengteng anegai ding uh," achi uhi. Huai lai in Zippor tapa Balak Moab kumpipa ahi.
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

paite: Huaiziak in Beor tapa Balaam, Pethor a om kiang ah mi asawl hi. Huai bel amite suante gam a lui kiang a om ahi. Amah ava sam ua, "Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan hong paikhia mipi a-om ua; ngai in, leitung maikaih atuamdim ua, ka kiangchin ah a-om uhi.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out from Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

paite: Hehpih in hong pai inla, hiai mite hong hamsiat dih ve. Kei a ding in ahat lua ua, ka zoh theih ua ka gam a pan ka delhkhiak theih zenzen khak uleh. Na vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in a-om a, na hamsiat peuhmah lah hamsiat in a-om, chih ka thei," ava chisak hi.
english: Please come now therefore curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

paite: Huchi in Moab upate leh Midian upate aisanna ding tawi in apawtkhia ua; Balaam kiang ava tung ua, Balak thukhah ahilh uhi.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tuzan hiai ah giak unla, TOUPA'N hon hilh bangbang thu na kiang ua ka hon tun ding," achi hi. Huchi in Moab miliante Balaam kiang ah agiakta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

paite: Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, na kiang a mite kuate ahi ua? achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

paite: Balaam in Pathian kiang ah, "Zippor tapa Moab kumpipa Balak in ka kiang ah,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

paite: 'Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan a hong pai mipite'n leitung maikaih aluahdim uh. Hong pai inla, hong hamsiat in, ka zoh theih a, ka delhkhiak theih khakleh,' " chi in mi ahon sawl hi, achi hi.
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt, it covers the surface of the earth: now, come curse me them; perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

paite: Pathian in Balaam kiang ah, "Akiang ua na hoh ding ahi kei. Huai mite na hamsiat ding ahi kei; mihampha ahi uh," achi hi.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people; for they are blessed.”

paite: Zingsang in Balaam athou a, Balak miliante kiang ah, "Na gam uah pai nawnta un. TOUPA'N na kiang ua hoh dia ka pawt aphal kei,” achi hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

paite: Huchi in Moab miliante athou ua, Balak kiang ah apai ua, "Balaam in ahon zui ut kei," achi uhi.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

paite: Balak in milian tamsem, asang ua zahtakhuaizaw asawl nawn hi.
english: Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.

paite: Balaam kiang ava tung ua, akiang ah, "Zippor tapa Balak in hichi in achi, 'Ka kiang a na hong hoh ding bangmah in dal kei hen.
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me:

paite: Mithupitak in ka hon bawl dia, ka kiang a na gen peuhmah ka hih zel ding. Huaiziak in hong pai teitei inla, hiai mite hong hamsiatsak mahmah mai in,' " achi uhi.
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

paite: Balaam in Balak mite adawng a, akiang uah, "Balak in a-inn dim dangka leh dangka-eng hon pe ding himahleh, abangmah TOUPA ka Pathian thu pel in ka hihthei kei.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah bangchi in ahia agen nawn ding, tuzan hiai lai ah giak peuhmah phot un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please wait also here this night, that I may know what Yahweh will speak to me more.”

paite: Zan in Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, akiang ah, "Hiai mite nang hong sam a hong ahih uleh, thou inla, akiang uah hoh in. Himahleh na kiang a ka gen kia na hih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

paite: Huchi in zingsang in Balaam athou a, asabiltung tung ah tutphah aphah a, Moab miliante azuita hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

paite: Huchi in ahoh ziak in Pathian aheh mahmah a, amah na lamdal ding in lampi ah TOUPA angel ana dingh hi. Asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, asikhate nih leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
heading: Balaam Leh Asabiltung
english: God’s anger was kindled because he went; and the angel of Yahweh placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel, namsau tawi a lampi a dingh amu hi. Huchi in lampi a pan sabiltung apialkhia a, gamlak ah apai a, Balaam in lampi a kiksak tum in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the way.

paite: Grephuan umna kikal kuak ah TOUPA angel adingh hi.
english: Then the angel of Yahweh stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, grephuan umna ava ngai a, dai umna toh Balaam khe anehden hi. Balaam in asabiltung asat nawn hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he struck her again.

paite: Apam deuh ah TOUPA angel apai a, mun kochik laitak, taklam hiam, veilam hiam a leng pialna omlouhna laitak ah adingh hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, Balaam akualpihta hi. Balaam aheh mahmah a, achiangkhun in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh, and she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

paite: TOUPA'N sabiltung apausak a, Balaam kiang ah, "Bang ka hon chih a ahia? Thumveitak na hon huchi sat?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

paite: Balaam in sabiltung kiang ah, "N'on simmoh ziak in ahi. Namsau tawi hi leng, ka hon that khin hialta ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

paite: Sabiltung in Balaam kiang ah, "Tutan a na tuanna gige na sabiltung ka hi kei a hia? Hichibang in ka hon hih ngei a hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hih ngei lou e,” achi hi.
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long to this day? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam mit avaksak a, TOUPA angel namsau tawi alampi a dingh amuta a; akun a, amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahweh standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a na sabiltung thumvei sat na hia? Ngai in, na gamtatdan ka mitmuh a asiat ziak in hon na lamdal dia hong pawtkhia ka hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come forth as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me:

paite: Sabiltung in ahon mu a, ka ma a thumvei pial ahi. Pial keileh amah that lou a, nang hon that khin ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: and the donkey saw me, and turned aside before me these three times. Unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

paite: Balaam in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka na khialta hi. Hon na lamdal ding in lampi ah na dingh chih ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to the angel of Yahweh, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

paite: TOUPA angel in Balaam kiang ah, "Hiai mite kiang ah hoh inla; himahleh na kiang a ka thugen ding kia na gen ding ahi," achi hi. Huchi in Balaam in Balak miliante azuita hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

paite: Balak in Balaam ahong chih azak in Arnon lam a gamgi chiang ah Moab khopi pha in ava dawn a, huai tuh gamgi tawpna ahi.
heading: Balak In Balaam Ana Vaidawn
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Phatuamngaitak a nang hong sam dia mi ka hon sawl ahi kei maw? Bangziak a ka kiang a hong nuam lou na hia? Mithupitak in ka hon bawl thei ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send to you to call you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hong hi. Bangmah gentheihna mawngmawng ka nei a hia? Pathian in ka kam a thu akoih kia ka gen ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you: have I now any power at all to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.”

paite: Huchi in Balak kiang ah Balaam ahohta a, Kiriath-huzot ava tung uhi.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

paite: Balak in bawng leh belam alan a, khenkhat Balaam leh akiang a om miliante kiang ah akhak hi.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Balak in Balaam api a, Baal mun sangte ah ahohtouhpih a, huai a pan mite omna chiang amupha hi.
heading: Balaam Thugen Masa
english: It happened in the morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there the utmost part of the people.
